title: Cultural Dynamics in Multi-Agent Systems: Joint Effects of Individual Openness and Information Flow on Culture Dissemination

contributions.purpose: 用 LLM 智能体升级 Axelrod 文化传播模型
contributions.mechanism: 100 个 Qwen3-8B 智能体置于 10×10 网格,引入开放度参数 α∈[0,1] 解耦心理接受度与相似度
contributions.evaluation: 3×3 因子设计(开放度 low/med/high × 交互范围 local/med/extended)(定性框架)
contributions.domain: 多智能体文化动力学/社会仿真
contributions.source_quote: We develop an enhanced cultural dissemination model using Qwen3-8B large language model agents... transcending the limitations of traditional rule-based approaches.

contributions.purpose: 量化开放度与信息流的主效应
contributions.mechanism: 统计各条件下文化同质性指数 CHI
contributions.evaluation: CHI 随开放度 0.266→0.434(+63%);扩展信息流较局部提升 53%
contributions.source_quote: Cultural Homogeneity Index increases from 0.266 to 0.434 with higher openness (+63%), while extended information flow yields 53% improvement over local interactions.

contributions.purpose: 揭示两因子的交互效应
contributions.mechanism: 比较保守/开放智能体在不同连通度下的表现
contributions.evaluation: 保守智能体局部连通更优、开放智能体广域网络更优(称"significant"但正文未见 p 值/检验)
contributions.source_quote: Crucially, we discover significant interaction effects—conservative agents perform better with local connectivity while open agents benefit from broader networks.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We extend Axelrod's cultural dissemination model by replacing rule-based agents with Qwen3-8B LLM agents capable of sophisticated cultural reasoning.

notes: Recombination 型:把经典 Axelrod ABM 的规则智能体替换成 LLM 智能体。数据红旗:反复声称"significant interaction effects"但正文/表未见任何 p 值或统计检验(仅 100 智能体单网格、种子数未报)——显著性主张无支撑。潜在循环自证:LLM 既扮演"开放度推理"又产出被测的文化结果,机制内生。代码匿名链接可查。reject。
